name: com.irlpls/irlpls
title: irlpls
description: Find providers of new real-world data (sensors, people, drones, satellites); plan a request.

environmentVariables.name: IRLPLS_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to plan only: no irlpls_submit, no ordering or provider calls.

remote.logging: none: no access log, no request bodies, no outbound calls
remote.rateLimit: 60 requests/min per client, burst 20; 600/min per server

package.orders: only after the user's explicit approval, with the user's own provider credentials
